data.body:
RCA / disposition:
- Root cause: pytest-xdist worker termination could reduce reported outcomes without producing an explicit test failure owned by rebar; process-level runner death statuses were also unnamed in logs.
- RED: `tests/unit/test_crash_guard.py` and `tests/scripts/test_classify_runner_exit.py` failed before implementation because the crash guard/plugin and exit classifier did not exist; CI patchset 1 also exposed the no-xdist optional-hook case.
- Fix: added `tests/_crash_guard.py` as a pytest plugin using `pytest_testnodedown` to convert abnormal xdist worker termination into an explicit failing exit status; added `scripts/classify_runner_exit.py`; wired CI to run the classifier; kept `tests/conftest.py` to minimal plugin registration.
- CI iteration: patchset 1 failed optionality because clean-core/no-xdist pytest treated `pytest_testnodedown` as an unknown hook; fixed with `@pytest.hookimpl(optionalhook=True)` plus regression test. Patchset 2 then saw two Verified infra failures from Google apt `Hash Sum mismatch`; both were rechecked with evidence. Final recheck passed.
- Verification: focused suites passed; full local `make verify` passed before the optional-hook amendment, and focused/related tests plus hooks passed after; Gerrit Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1.

Gerrit change: 2927, merged.
Close class: normal completion.
